title: US equity markets closed — Washington's Birthday / Presidents Day (falls INSIDE February opex week in 2027)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L and renders its holiday data as JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup) and parsed cell-by-cell by this session. The page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; against the year headers 2026 / 2027 / 2028 its 'Washington's Birthday' row parses exactly as ['Monday, February 16', 'Monday, February 15', 'Monday, February 21'] — i.e. the NYSE is closed Monday 2027-02-15. Independently reproduced by weekday arithmetic: the third Monday of February 2027 is 2027-02-15 (5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Washington's Birthday on the third Monday), and the same computation returns 2026-02-16 and 2028-02-21, matching the page on both other years. No footnote attaches to this row, so no early close is recommended on any adjacent session. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the sibling good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a securities exchange's own holiday calendar (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:), and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2027-02-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and it is the second market-CLOSURE entry on this calendar after good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26. The opex-2027-02-19 seeding note already mentioned the short week in prose; what was missing is the closure as a calendar ENTRY, so nothing screening or scanning that corridor could see it. Why a day the market is shut earns a row: it falls on the MONDAY of the February 2027 monthly options expiration week (opex-2027-02-19, estimate), making that a four-session week. TWO CORRECTIONS the discovering ledger computed rather than assumed, both of which shrink the claim. (1) NOT A SEASONAL REGULARITY: whether the third Monday lands inside the third-Friday week depends on where February starts, and across 2015-2035 it does so in only 9 of 21 years (43%) - 2015, 2016, 2020, 2021, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2031, 2032, exactly the years whose third Friday is the 19th, 20th or 21st. In the other 12 the holiday is the FOLLOWING Monday and the expiration week is an ordinary five sessions. 2025/2026/2027 is the only unbroken three-year run in that window. (2) IT COMPRESSES NOTHING IN SESSION TERMS: counted mechanically, the last five sessions before the expiration are 2027-02-12, 02-16, 02-17, 02-18 and 02-19 - five, the same as any other cycle, the window simply reaching one day further back. What actually changes is calendar SPAN: those five sessions cover 7 calendar days instead of the usual 4 (+75%), with all of the extra time inside one non-trading gap (Fri 02-12 close to Tue 02-16 open) that cannot be hedged across. Since option time value decays in calendar time while hedging happens in session time, the honest statement is that this cycle front-loads three calendar days of decay into a single un-hedgeable gap four sessions before expiry - a real asymmetry, and a much smaller claim than 'the pin window is compressed'. THE HOLIDAY ALSO PROVABLY CANNOT MOVE THE EXPIRATION: Cboe's settlement page, fetched the same session, shows the third-Friday convention breaking exactly once across its whole 2026-09 to 2027-12 listing, and that break (VA/M7 settling 2027-06-17, VX/K7 2027-05-18) is caused by Juneteenth observed on a FRIDAY, 2027-06-18. A Monday holiday is structurally incapable of producing it. Impact LOW and structural only: a closed session moves nothing by itself and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. FIXED INCOME NOT ASSERTED: SIFMA's own press release confirms its 2027 US recommendations are published, but the 2027 tab panel on sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule renders empty from this runner (HTTP 200, 23,533 bytes, tabpanel div with no children); its readable 2026 panel lists Presidents Day as a plain full close with NO flanking early-close recommendation, unlike Good Friday, Memorial Day, July 4th, Thanksgiving and Christmas which all carry one - which is why no sifma-bond-early-close entry is proposed alongside this one. That is 2026 evidence about a pattern, not a 2027 assertion. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no slot for an exchange-schedule event, so this is filed 'sector', the same least-wrong choice the Good Friday sibling documented. AMENDED 2026-09-05 by initial research (docs/research/events/presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15.md), which resolves two things this note left open. (1) FIXED INCOME IS NOW ASSERTED FOR 2027: the SIFMA 2027 US panel was retrieved this time by parsing the page's own embedded React payload rather than the rendered text (HTTP 200, 298,899 bytes) - it lists 'Presidents Day, Monday, February 15, 2027' with an EMPTY early-close note, against six other 2027 US holidays on the same list that each carry one (Good Friday 2:00pm Thu 03-25, Memorial Day 2:00pm Fri 05-28, Independence Day 2:00pm Fri 07-02, Thanksgiving 2:00pm Fri 11-26, Christmas 2:00pm Thu 12-23, New Year's 2:00pm Fri 12-31). So 2027-02-15 is a plain full bond close with no flanking early close, and no sifma-bond-early-close entry is proposed alongside it. (2) THE 'UN-HEDGEABLE GAP' FRAMING IN THIS NOTE IS A TRAP, NOT AN OPPORTUNITY, and the ledger re-frames it: measured on SPY/VIX daily bars 2010-01-01 to 2026-09-04, the 3-day weekend's median absolute opening gap is 0.404% over three calendar days against 0.302% over two - PER CALENDAR DAY 0.135% vs 0.151%, i.e. LOWER, because both spans hold exactly one non-trading interval and risk accrues in sessions - while implied vol is marked down harder into the pre-holiday Friday close (mean dVIX -0.303 vs -0.176) and rebounds harder on reopen (median +0.575 vs +0.150; higher 71% of the time, 60/84, against 56%, 422/755). The extra decay is charged for at the Friday close, not collected by holding through. DUPLICATE FLAGGED: washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15 is the same NYSE row, same date, also filed 2026-09-05, discovered by a different adjacency sweep that could not see this one; --validate passes because it only enforces filename == id. Which entry survives is a calendar-ownership call this lane does not make from inside one of the two - it is filed as its own issue.
